props.name: value
props.description: Controlled point. `null` while the text does not parse.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the parsed point on every valid edit, and `null` when the text stops parsing.

props.name: reference
props.description: Measure distance and initial bearing from this point to the entered one.

props.name: unit
props.description: Distance unit for the reference line.

props.name: precision
props.description: Decimal places in the normalised decimal output.

props.name: formats
props.description: Notations offered for copying, in order.

props.name: hint
props.description: Guidance under the field while it is valid.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims the control.
